_comment: METRICS 10 cases, checked by spec/tools/traffic.py. Times are Unix ms; counters are cumulative bytes. A process row: pid, ppid, start (ms), exe, optional args, bundle (macOS: CFBundleIdentifier of the .app whose Contents/MacOS holds exe), cwd, openFiles. A counter sample: stream id (a new id starts a new stream unless continues is true) and rows of pid, start, rx, tx. Agents: id, source, optional parent, cwdPath, transcript, active intervals [from, to] (phase generating/tools or new lines). Expected values are written by hand from the spec; only the keys present are compared.

cases.name: classify-windows-observed
cases._comment: Process trees observed on Windows 11 on 2026-10-25: Claude Desktop 3.6556 runs app\claude.exe in lower case, so Windows names compare case-insensitively and the desktop apps are known by their package's app folder; DeepSeek Harness runs its desktop host and runners on its own executable.

cases.name: tunnel-and-local-proxy
cases._comment: Issue #35. Rows are what `nettop -t external -t undefined` lists (METRICS 10.3). codex runs behind a TUN-mode proxy: its socket on the tunnel interface is `undefined` and counts once, as its own. The proxy core verge-mihomo sends codex's traffic on and serves claude as a local HTTP proxy; it is no agent's process and is never counted. claude reaches that proxy only over loopback, which nettop does not list, so its row does not grow (METRICS 10.12). codex's ssh tool goes straight out over en0.
